subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world statistics and probability word problems using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student runs a virtual survey or probability game and analyzes the collected results
exercise.pictorial: Student builds a chart or diagram to represent a one-step statistics/probability word problem
exercise.abstract: Student solves a one-step mean, median, or probability word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot decide whether a problem calls for mean, median, or probability

interest_binding: word problems and scenarios generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
